purpose: Resolve China Grade 1-6 browse requests without converting learning-stage evidence into unverified exact textbook placement.

browse_modes.rule: Use China curriculum placement/learning-stage records and jurisdiction-specific domain overrides.
Use the neutral concept taxonomy; grade/stage relevance appears as a status, not as a taxonomy rewrite.

eligibility_statuses.label_zh: 现行人教版位置已核实

eligibility_statuses.display_rule: May show the China learning stage and curriculum section; do not state an exact semester or exact grade introduction point.
May appear in a separate Mathematical Practices section; do not invent a year introduction point.
May be shown below core stage content when mathematically useful, clearly separated from current China curriculum placement.

eligibility_statuses.label_zh: 当前中国小学课程未作为独立要求
eligibility_statuses.label_en: Not a standalone current China primary requirement
eligibility_statuses.display_rule: Do not place in the default core list; surface only through search/comparison or an explicit related-content view.

resolution_order: Map selected China grade to learning stage.
If a verified current PEP placement includes the selected grade, assign verified_current_pep.
Otherwise, if the official China curriculum record places the concept in the selected learning stage, assign stage_relevant.
If the concept is a cross-cutting mathematical-practice competency rather than a grade topic, assign cross_cutting.
If the concept is mathematically related but outside the selected China stage, do not promote it into the core list; optionally assign related_extension.
If the 2022 standard explicitly moves/removes the concept from primary or no current primary requirement exists, assign not_primary_requirement.

percent-meaning.reason: The 2022 China standard places percentage in Statistics and Probability and emphasises statistical meaning.

fraction-decimal-percent.reason: Fraction-decimal relationships and percentage are split across China curriculum domains; do not force the neutral three-form concept into one China curriculum domain.

negative-numbers.reason: Primary China treatment is contextual/integrated rather than a standalone negative-number arithmetic strand in the 2022 standard.

sort_rules: Within a China curriculum domain, prefer verified_current_pep before stage_relevant.
Do not sort concepts into an invented Grade 1→Grade 2 order when evidence is only Stage 1.
Use neutral subdomain order for concepts with equal evidence status unless current PEP unit order is verified.
Cross-cutting practices are shown after content domains by default.

teacher_facing_labels.stage_warning_zh: 国家课程按学段规定；现行教材具体年级/册次尚未全部核实。
teacher_facing_labels.stage_warning_en: The national curriculum specifies this at learning-stage level; exact current textbook grade/semester placement has not yet been fully verified.

hard_rules: Never convert Stage 1 into a claim that every Stage 1 concept is introduced in both Grade 1 and Grade 2.
Never use legacy PEP unit order as the current browse order.
A selected China grade is a navigation context, not evidence of exact concept introduction in that grade.
England Year and Common Core Grade are resolved only after the teacher opens a concept comparison; they do not control China browse eligibility.
